review_text: Balcony Safety Nets installed perfectly! They were punctual, which is a huge plus. The netting seems really durable and I'm told it's rust proof, a must for Chennai's weather. I feel much safer now letting my kids play on the balcony. Installation was quick and efficient. A trustworthy service, and hopefully, long lasting! Giving 4 stars as only time will tell the actual longevity.
